title: Dictionary learning for Kernel EDMD
abstract: arXiv:2604.25572v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Studying nonlinear dynamical systems through their state space behavior can be challenging, and one possible alternative is to analyze them via their associated Koopman operator. This turns the nonlinear problem into a linear, infinite-dimensional one. To approximate the operator in finite dimensions, extended dynamic mode decomposition (EDMD) is a commonly used algorithm. It requires a finite list of functionals and a set of snapshots from the system to compute an approximation of the operator and its corresponding spectrum. Instead of choosing the list of functionals directly, it can be implicitly defined via kernels, a method known as kernel extended dynamic mode decomposition (kEDMD). However, one still needs to define the kernel and choose its parameter values. translated_title: 核扩展动态模态分解的字典学习
translated_abstract: 通过状态空间行为来研究非线性动力系统可能颇具挑战性，一种可行的替代方法是借助其关联的 Koopman 算子来进行分析。这将非线性问题转化为线性、无穷维的问题。为了在有限维空间中逼近该算子，扩展动态模态分解（EDMD）是一种常用的算法。它需要一个有限的泛函列表和一组系统快照，以计算算子的近似及其对应的谱。与其直接选择泛函列表，不如通过核函数将其隐式定义，这种方法被称为核扩展动态模态分解（kEDMD）。然而，人们仍然需要定义核函数并选择其参数值。在本文中，我们旨在通过将 EDMD 的字典学习扩展为 kEDMD 中的核学习，来简化这一过程。通过简化 kEDMD，我们展示了如何进行……
tldr: 本文将 EDMD 中的字典学习方法扩展到 kEDMD 中的核学习，实现了核函数及其参数的自动学习，从而简化了 kEDMD 中核函数定义与参数选择的繁琐过程。
en_tdlr: This paper extends dictionary learning from EDMD to kernel learning in kEDMD, enabling automatic learning of the kernel and its parameters, thereby streamlining the process of kernel definition and parameter selection in kernel extended dynamic mode decomposition.
